parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region ID of the snapshot-consistent group. You can call [DescribeRegions](~~25609~~) to query the most recent list of regions.

parameters.name: SnapshotGroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the snapshot-consistent group. You can call [DescribeSnapshotGroups](~~210940~~) to query snapshot-consistent group IDs.
